detail:
no mobiusengine-jobs credential in this org — mobiusengine-jobs.jobs.company is a marketplace endpoint
  connect one:  treg connections connect --provider mobiusengine-jobs
  or add a key: treg secret add mobiusengine-jobs --env-var MOBIUSENGINE_JOBS_API_KEY
  or register the tool yourself: treg tool add mobiusengine-jobs --base-url https://jobs-api.arihaan.ai …
another provider serves companies.jobs:
  apollo.companies.jobs  ~$0.026/call  (callable now on treg's key)
